_about: Logger configuration for the ADL-200A, one entry per logger channel. "sweep" and "analog" set the channel inputs (channels.py --apply writes them to the logger); the rest is typed in from the manufacturer's calibration sheet and is used by the console tools only. Copy to /etc/adl200a/sensors.json.
_inputs: sweep: "auto" (narrowest band covering hz_min..hz_max), 1..4, or null for no VW input. analog: thermistor_3k, mv, bridge, resistance, rtd, serial, or null. Optional top-level "logger": {"recording": {"interval_min": 15, "mode": "fixed", "when_full": "overwrite"}} sets the logger's own recording.
_raw_unit: Как читать целое TYPE 01: hz, hz_x100, digits, digits_x10 или auto (подбирается по hz_min/hz_max на первом реальном отсчёте и запоминается). На этом приборе подтверждено hz_x100.
